evidence_summary: Cellosaurus maps both DepMap ACH-001189 and ACH-000833 to the same Rh30 identity, CVCL_0041. DepMap also lists ACH-001189 as a related model of ACH-000833. This record is excluded from benchmark labelling to prevent duplicate credit for the same biological cell line.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms the RD identity, rhabdomyosarcoma diagnosis and DepMap accession. An independent immunocytochemical study directly found RD cells positive for desmin protein expression.
review_notes: Suitable as a DES protein-expression positive reference. The candidate-pool ATCC discontinuation flag appears outdated and should not be used as evidence against biological suitability.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus identifies Rh18 as CVCL_1659 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000689. The original characterization study of Rh10, Rh18 and Rh28 reported antibody reactivity to desmin and vimentin, directly supporting Desmin protein expression in Rh18.
review_notes: Suitable as a DES protein-expression positive reference. The original study establishes antibody reactivity but does not quantify Desmin abundance. Rh18 has reported fusion-positive and fusion-negative variants, so this expression label must not be used to infer fusion status.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms the Rh41 identity, alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma diagnosis and DepMap accession. An independent qRT-PCR study directly measured DESMIN RNA expression in Rh41 cells.
review_notes: Suitable as a DES RNA-expression positive reference. The external study supports transcript expression but does not independently establish Desmin protein expression; the local proteomics value is retained only as a consistency check.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms the HLF identity, adult hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis and DepMap ACH-000393 mapping, but does not report a direct DES expression result. No independent study directly establishing Desmin positivity or negativity in HLF was verified.
review_notes: Do not classify HLF as DES-negative from the low internal RNA value or as DES-positive from the local proteomics value. The discordant internal RNA and protein measurements make this a targeted validation case; exclude it from the gold standard until an independent DES assay is available.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus identifies Rh30 as CVCL_0041 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000833. An independent Human Protein Atlas immunofluorescence assay detected Desmin protein in Rh30 cells with localization to intermediate filaments.
review_notes: Use ACH-000833 as the canonical Rh30 representation in the benchmark. Human Protein Atlas immunofluorescence provides direct protein-expression evidence independent of the local CCLE-Gygi protein score. ACH-001189 represents the same Cellosaurus cell line and should not be counted as a second independent positive.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms the LPS853 identity, dedifferentiated liposarcoma diagnosis and DepMap ACH-001802 mapping, but does not report a direct DES expression result. No independent study directly establishing Desmin RNA or protein expression in LPS853 was verified.
review_notes: The high internal DES RNA value is derived from a single available RNA source and cannot serve as its own external benchmark label. Do not infer DES negativity from the liposarcoma diagnosis. Exclude this record from the gold standard until an independent qPCR, immunoblot, immunofluorescence or flow-cytometry result is available.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus identifies RMS-YM, also named RMSYM, as CVCL_A792 and maps it to DepMap ACH-002048. The original cell-line characterization study directly reported expression of desmin and human myoglobin in RMS-YM.
review_notes: Suitable as a DES protein-expression positive reference. The original study establishes Desmin expression but does not provide a modern standardized abundance measurement. The candidate-pool NOT_IN_CELLOSAURUS risk flag is outdated because RMS-YM now has the Cellosaurus accession CVCL_A792.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms the Kuramochi identity, high-grade ovarian serous adenocarcinoma diagnosis and DepMap ACH-000524 mapping, but does not report a direct DES expression result. No independent study directly establishing Desmin RNA or protein expression in Kuramochi was verified.
review_notes: Do not classify Kuramochi as DES-positive from the local RNA and proteomics values, because those measurements are model inputs rather than independent benchmark evidence. Do not infer DES negativity from ovarian lineage. Exclude this record from the gold standard until an independent gene-specific qPCR, immunoblot, immunofluorescence or flow-cytometry result is available.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that Rh36 is CVCL_M599, maps it to DepMap ACH-001751 and identifies it as an embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma cell line. An independent study including Rh36 reported positive immunohistochemical staining for Desmin in xenografts generated from adherent and sphere-derived cells.
review_notes: Suitable as a DES protein-expression positive reference. This candidate is particularly useful because the local candidate-pool record has RNA evidence but no local proteomics measurement, while independent immunohistochemistry demonstrates detectable Desmin protein. The study supports protein detectability but does not provide a standardized quantitative abundance value.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that RMZ-RC2 is CVCL_L510, maps it to DepMap ACH-001743 and identifies it as an alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma cell line derived as an RC2 subclone of RMZ. The original characterization study detected Desmin by immunofluorescence and reported that approximately 71.7% of RC2 cells expressed Desmin.
review_notes: Suitable as a DES protein-expression positive reference. The candidate-pool record has RNA evidence but no local proteomics value, while independent immunofluorescence directly establishes Desmin protein expression. The reported percentage comes from cytocentrifuged preparations and should not be treated as a standardized proteomic abundance.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus and ATCC confirm the identity of HCC1395 as CVCL_1249 and DepMap ACH-000699, a triple-negative breast cancer cell line. Neither source reports a direct DES expression result, and no independent gene-specific experiment directly establishing Desmin RNA or protein expression in HCC1395 was verified.
review_notes: The local candidate-pool record shows low RNA but high proteomics evidence for DES, creating a modality discrepancy that cannot be resolved using the model inputs themselves. Do not classify HCC1395 as positive from the local protein value or as negative from its breast lineage or low RNA value. Exclude it from the gold standard until an independent DES-specific assay is available.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus identifies JR as CVCL_RT33, maps it to DepMap ACH-001096 and classifies it as an alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma cell line. An independent xenograft study explicitly reported that JR alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma tumors stained positive for Desmin and skeletal muscle-specific actin.
review_notes: Suitable as a DES protein-expression positive reference. JR CVCL_RT33 must not be confused with the distinct JR-1 CVCL_J063 embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma cell line. The independent evidence is Desmin immunohistochemistry in JR-derived xenograft tumors; it demonstrates protein detectability but not a standardized quantitative abundance.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that Huh-7 is CVCL_0336, maps it to DepMap ACH-000480 and identifies it as an adult hepatocellular carcinoma cell line. An independent flow-cytometry study described Huh-7 as an AFP-producing human hepatoma cell line and directly detected intracellular AFP using indirect immunofluorescence.
review_notes: Suitable as an AFP protein-expression positive reference. The study directly demonstrates intracellular AFP and discusses AFP production and secretion. The local RNA and proteomics values are retained only as consistency checks and are not used as the external benchmark label.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that Fu97 is CVCL_2908, maps it to DepMap ACH-000633 and identifies it as a gastric adenocarcinoma cell line that produces high levels of AFP. An independent study found significantly higher AFP expression in Fu97 than in comparator gastric cancer cell lines at both the mRNA and protein levels and confirmed cytoplasmic AFP by immunofluorescence.
review_notes: Suitable as a strong AFP expression-positive gastric cancer reference. The independent study directly measured AFP RNA and protein and confirmed its cellular localization. The absence of a local proteomics value represents missing internal coverage and does not contradict the external protein evidence. Local RNA values are retained only as consistency checks.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that JHH-7 is CVCL_2805, maps it to DepMap ACH-000848 and identifies it as an adult hepatocellular carcinoma cell line. The original characterization study reported that JHH-7 functionally synthesized and secreted AFP together with albumin, CEA and ferritin.
review_notes: Suitable as an AFP protein-expression positive reference. The original study directly establishes AFP synthesis and secretion. JHH-7 contains integrated incomplete HBV genomes but does not secrete HBsAg; this annotation does not invalidate the AFP expression label. Local RNA and proteomics values are retained only as consistency checks.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that JHH-5 is CVCL_0364, maps it to DepMap ACH-000734 and identifies it as an adult hepatocellular carcinoma cell line. The JCRB cell-bank record reports AFP at 110 ng/mL over 48 hours in the cell-culture supernatant, directly demonstrating AFP secretion.
review_notes: Suitable as an AFP protein-expression positive reference. The reported AFP concentration in culture supernatant provides direct quantitative secretion evidence. Distribution restrictions or discontinued-provider annotations do not invalidate the biological expression label. Local RNA and proteomics values are retained only as consistency checks.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that HCC2429 is CVCL_5132, maps it to DepMap ACH-000143 and identifies it as a lung non-small cell carcinoma and NUT carcinoma cell line. Cellosaurus does not report AFP expression, and no independent AFP-specific experiment directly establishing AFP RNA or protein expression in HCC2429 was verified.
review_notes: The local candidate-pool record contains high AFP RNA values but no protein measurement. These model inputs cannot be reused as an external benchmark label. Do not classify HCC2429 as AFP-positive until an independent AFP-specific qPCR, immunoblot, immunofluorescence or secretion assay is available.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that Hep-G2 is CVCL_0027 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000739, while noting that the line is misclassified and is now considered hepatoblastoma rather than hepatocellular carcinoma. An independent pulse-chase and immunoisolation study directly demonstrated rapid secretion of alpha-fetoprotein by Hep-G2 cells.
review_notes: Suitable as an AFP protein-expression positive reference, but not as an adult hepatocellular carcinoma-specific model. Reports must disclose that Hep-G2 is a hepatoblastoma-derived, historically misclassified cell line. Local RNA and proteomics values are used only as consistency checks.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that Hep 3B2.1-7 is CVCL_0326 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000625. An independent study described Hep3B as expressing AFP at a high level and directly evaluated AFP using western blotting, ELISA and qRT-PCR.
review_notes: Suitable as a strong AFP RNA- and protein-expression positive reference. The independent study directly measured AFP using three complementary assays. Hep 3B2.1-7 contains an integrated hepatitis B virus genome, which should be disclosed as biological context but does not invalidate the AFP-positive label. Local RNA and proteomics values are retained only as consistency checks.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that GCIY is CVCL_1228, maps it to DepMap ACH-000047 and identifies it as a gastric adenocarcinoma cell line that produces AFP. An independent study described abundant AFP expression in GCIY and directly evaluated AFP at the mRNA and protein levels using RT-qPCR and western blotting.
review_notes: Suitable as an AFP RNA- and protein-expression positive gastric cancer reference. The independent experimental study directly measured both expression modalities. The absence of a local proteomics value represents missing internal coverage and does not contradict the external protein evidence. Local RNA values are retained only as consistency checks.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus and DSMZ confirm that F-36P is CVCL_2037, maps to DepMap ACH-000487 and is an acute erythroid leukemia cell line. Neither source reports a direct AFP expression result, and no independent gene-specific experiment directly establishing AFP RNA or protein expression in F-36P was verified.
review_notes: The local candidate-pool record shows high AFP RNA but low proteomics evidence, creating a modality discrepancy that cannot be resolved using the model inputs themselves. Do not classify F-36P as AFP-positive from the local RNA value or as negative from its leukemia lineage or low protein value. Exclude it from the gold standard until an independent AFP-specific assay is available.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that KNS-42 is CVCL_0378 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000622. The original characterization study directly detected GFAP in KNS-42, reporting expression in most cells under sparse-culture conditions and quantifying GFAP at 530 to 990 ng per mg of protein.
review_notes: Suitable as a GFAP protein-expression positive reference. The original study provides direct immunochemical and quantitative protein evidence. GFAP abundance depended on cell density, so culture conditions should be disclosed when interpreting experimental suitability. Local RNA and proteomics values are retained only as consistency checks.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that SNU-201 is CVCL_5033, maps it to DepMap ACH-000623 and identifies it as a glioblastoma cell line. The retained accessible source does not report a direct GFAP assay in SNU-201, and no independent cell-line-specific GFAP RNA or protein result was verified.
review_notes: The local candidate-pool record contains high GFAP RNA values but no protein measurement. These internal model inputs cannot create an external benchmark label. Do not classify SNU-201 as GFAP-positive solely from its glioblastoma lineage or local RNA value. Exclude it from the gold standard until a direct cell-line-specific GFAP assay is verified.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that U-251MG is CVCL_0021 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000232. One independent study directly confirmed GFAP expression in U-251MG by western blotting, whereas another western blot study reported no detectable GFAP in U251, demonstrating conflicting cell-line-specific protein evidence.
review_notes: Do not use U-251MG as a stable GFAP positive or negative gold label. The conflicting results may reflect differences in cell stocks, passage history, culture conditions or assay sensitivity. It remains a useful condition-dependent audit case, but should be excluded from formal metric calculation until the relevant stock and experimental conditions are specified.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that KNS-81 is CVCL_2799 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000479. An independent study directly immunostained cultured astrocytoma cell lines and reported GFAP immunoreactivity in KNS-81 cells.
review_notes: Suitable as a GFAP protein-expression positive reference. The evidence is cell-line-specific and based on direct immunostaining of cultured KNS-81 cells. Its slow growth should be considered when assessing assay practicality, but does not invalidate the GFAP-positive biological label. Local RNA and proteomics values are retained only as consistency checks.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that REC-1 is CVCL_1884, maps it to DepMap ACH-000068 and identifies it as a mantle cell lymphoma cell line. No direct external REC-1-specific CD45/PTPRC RNA or protein assay was verified in the accessible sources reviewed.
review_notes: Do not classify REC-1 as PTPRC-positive solely from its lymphoma lineage, CD19/CD20 phenotype or local RNA/protein values. Exclude it from the formal gold standard until a direct REC-1 CD45 RNA or protein assay is verified.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that MOLT-16 is CVCL_1424 and identifies it as a T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia cell line. DSMZ reports multiple T-cell immunophenotypic markers, but the accessible immunology panel does not report CD45/PTPRC, and no direct cell-line-specific CD45 assay was verified.
review_notes: T-cell lineage alone is insufficient to create a PTPRC-positive gold label. Keep MOLT-16 as unknown and exclude it from formal metric calculation until direct CD45 RNA or protein evidence is verified.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that RL is CVCL_1660 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000371. ATCC reports Hle-1-positive antigen expression in RL, and the Hle-1 antibody is an anti-CD45 antibody, providing direct evidence of cell-surface CD45/PTPRC expression.
review_notes: Suitable as a PTPRC/CD45 protein-expression positive reference. The label is supported by direct cell-surface antigen testing rather than inferred from lymphoma lineage or internal RNA/proteomics values.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that SMZ-1 is CVCL_RL84 and maps it to DepMap ACH-001197. The original cell-line characterization reported several T-cell antigens, including CD2, CD3 and CD4, but did not report a direct CD45/PTPRC result. No independent SMZ-1-specific CD45 RNA or protein assay was verified.
review_notes: Do not infer PTPRC positivity solely from the T-cell lymphoma lineage or the expression of other T-cell markers. Keep SMZ-1 as unknown and exclude it from formal metric calculation until a direct cell-line-specific CD45 assay is verified.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that SUP-T11 is CVCL_2210 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000122. An independent immunophenotyping study reported intense CD45RA expression in SUP-T11 cells and used anti-human CD45 antibodies to identify SUP-T11 cells, providing direct evidence of CD45/PTPRC protein expression.
review_notes: Suitable as a PTPRC/CD45 protein-expression positive reference. CD45RA is a cell-surface isoform of the PTPRC gene product. The external immunophenotyping evidence is independent of the local RNA ranking.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that Loucy is CVCL_1380 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000104. An independent xenograft study quantified human CD45-positive cells by flow cytometry after inoculation with transduced LOUCY cells, providing direct evidence that the Loucy cells express cell-surface CD45/PTPRC protein.
review_notes: Suitable as a PTPRC/CD45 protein-expression positive reference. The evidence comes from anti-human CD45 flow cytometry in a Loucy xenograft model. Local RNA values are retained only as an internal consistency check.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that WSU-DLCL2 is CVCL_1902, maps it to DepMap ACH-000534 and identifies it as a diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cell line. No direct external WSU-DLCL2-specific CD45/PTPRC RNA or protein assay was verified in the accessible sources reviewed.
review_notes: Do not infer PTPRC positivity solely from the B-cell lymphoma lineage or expression of other B-cell markers such as CD20. Keep WSU-DLCL2 as unknown and exclude it from formal metric calculation until a direct cell-line-specific CD45 assay is verified.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that CMK is CVCL_0216, maps it to DepMap ACH-000641 and identifies it as an acute megakaryocytic leukemia cell line. Accessible CMK studies primarily used megakaryocytic, myeloid or c-kit markers, and no unambiguous CMK-specific CD45/PTPRC result was verified.
review_notes: Do not infer CD45 status from the acute megakaryocytic leukemia diagnosis because CD45 expression can be heterogeneous in this disease. The local RNA and protein values cannot independently create an external gold label. Exclude CMK from formal metric calculation until a direct assay is verified.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms that SR is CVCL_1711 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000338. ATCC reports Hle-1-positive antigen expression in SR, and Hle-1 is an anti-CD45 antibody, providing direct evidence of cell-surface CD45/PTPRC protein expression.
review_notes: Suitable as a PTPRC/CD45 protein-expression positive reference. The discontinued DepMap identifier and absent growth-pattern information affect practical assay suitability but do not invalidate the external CD45-positive biological label.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms SU-DHL-4 as CVCL_0539 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000365. One antibody-binding study reported strong binding of the anti-CD45 antibody YTH24.5 to the tested cell lines including SU-DHL-4, whereas an independent immunohistochemical study reported no CD45 staining in SU-DHL-4. These assay-specific results are conflicting.
review_notes: Exclude SU-DHL-4 from formal metric calculation because direct external CD45 results conflict across antibody-binding and immunohistochemical assays. An additional authenticated flow-cytometry or western-blot result is required before assigning a positive or negative label.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms Karpas-422 as CVCL_1325 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000315. The original cell-line characterization study used flow cytometry and reported strong CD45 and CD45R expression, with both markers scored as strongly positive in Table 1.
review_notes: Suitable as a PTPRC/CD45 protein-expression positive reference. The discontinued DSMZ record, slow growth and missing growth-pattern information affect practical assay suitability but do not invalidate the biological positive label.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms HuT 102 as CVCL_3526 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000612. An independent CTCL cell-line study included Hut102 and reported that the CD45RO protein isoform was strongly expressed in all examined cell lines using immunohistochemical analysis of xenograft tumors.
review_notes: Suitable as a PTPRC/CD45 protein-expression positive reference. The external result specifically measures the CD45RO protein isoform in xenograft tissue rather than total CD45 in cultured cells; this distinction should be retained in the audit record.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms F-36P as CVCL_2037 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000487. The authenticated ECACC cell-bank record reports that F-36P is positive for leukocyte common antigen CD45, together with CD13, CD33 and CD34.
review_notes: Suitable as a PTPRC/CD45 protein-expression positive reference based on the authenticated ECACC immunophenotype record. F-36P is cytokine-dependent, but this culture requirement does not invalidate the CD45-positive biological label.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus and JCRB confirm DL-40 as CVCL_2889, map it to DepMap ACH-001060 and identify it as an ALK-negative anaplastic large-cell lymphoma line. The accessible authenticated cell-bank record documents CD30-associated and T-cell characteristics but does not provide a direct DL-40-specific CD45/PTPRC assay result.
review_notes: Do not infer CD45 positivity solely from the T-cell lymphoma lineage or from commercial descriptions without a traceable assay. Exclude DL-40 from formal metric calculation until a primary study or authenticated cell-bank record directly reports CD45/PTPRC measurement.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms SU-DHL-6 as CVCL_2206 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000611. An independent immunohistochemical study detected CD45 in SU-DHL-6 at all tested antibody concentrations with or without antigen retrieval, and Table 5 reports a strong LCA/CD45 staining score of +3.
review_notes: Suitable as a PTPRC/CD45 protein-expression positive reference based on direct immunohistochemical detection. The result contrasts with the CD45-negative staining reported for SU-DHL-4 in the same experiment.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms HT as CVCL_1290 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000914. ATCC reports Hle-1-positive antigen expression in HT, and Hle-1 is an anti-CD45 antibody, providing direct evidence of cell-surface CD45/PTPRC protein expression.
review_notes: Suitable as a PTPRC/CD45 protein-expression positive reference based on the authenticated ATCC immunophenotype. Missing growth-pattern information affects practical assay documentation but does not invalidate the biological positive label.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus and RIKEN BRC confirm the identity of HOUA-I as CVCL_3867 and an endometrial carcinoma cell line. These sources provide identity and provenance information only; neither source reports a direct HOUA-I-specific MSLN/mesothelin assay result.
review_notes: Identity verified, but MSLN expression status remains unknown. Exclude this row from formal metric calculation.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus and JCRB confirm the identity of OCUM-1 as CVCL_3084 and JCRB0192 and identify it as a gastric cancer cell line. The authenticated JCRB record reports several other tumor markers but does not report a direct OCUM-1-specific MSLN/mesothelin assay result.
review_notes: Identity verified, but MSLN expression status remains unknown. Do not use the local DepMap-derived expression values as external evidence. Exclude this row from formal metric calculation.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms the identity of OVKATE as CVCL_3110 and DepMap ACH-000443. However, no directly traceable OVKATE-specific MSLN/mesothelin protein or RNA assay result was identified from the reviewed external sources.
review_notes: Identity verified, but MSLN expression status remains unknown. Exclude this row from formal metric calculation.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms SNU-119 as CVCL_5014 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000635. Although the entry lists transcriptomic and proteomic datasets, it does not report a directly interpretable SNU-119-specific MSLN/mesothelin assay result.
review_notes: Identity verified, but MSLN expression status remains unknown. Dataset participation alone is not treated as external expression evidence. Exclude this row from formal metric calculation.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms Capan-2 as CVCL_0026 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000107. An independent study measured mesothelin by western blotting, FACS and immunocytochemistry and reported that Capan-2 showed the strongest mesothelin expression among four pancreatic cancer cell lines.
review_notes: Suitable as an MSLN-high expression positive reference. The slow-growth warning affects practical assay planning but does not invalidate the biological positive label.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms UACC-257 as CVCL_1779 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000579. Independent studies describe UACC-257 as an MITF-amplified melanoma cell line and directly assessed MITF protein in UACC-257 by immunoblotting.
review_notes: Suitable as an MITF-positive reference supported by both gene amplification and direct protein measurement. The no-growth-pattern flag affects assay documentation but not the biological positive label.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms IGR-37 as CVCL_2075 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000650. Independent studies classify IGR-37 as an MITF-high or MITF-positive melanoma cell line and directly detect MITF protein by western blotting.
review_notes: Suitable as an MITF protein-expression positive reference. Its slow growth should be retained as a practical assay-planning consideration.

evidence_summary: Cellosaurus confirms SK-MEL-3 as CVCL_0550 and maps it to DepMap ACH-000423. Independent studies measured endogenous MITF in SK-MEL-3, including MITF protein by western blotting and treatment-associated changes at both mRNA and protein levels.
review_notes: Suitable as an MITF expression-positive reference based on direct protein and RNA measurements.
